800:   /**

802:    * `userTurn` is given it is appended to that history, otherwise the last
803:    * message of `base` is the turn being re-answered. The new assistant turn is
804:    * parented to `assistantParentId`, which is how branches stay linked.
805:    */
806:   const runTurn = useCallback(
807:     async (
808:       base: ChatMessage[],
809:       userTurn: ChatMessage | null,
810:       assistantParentId: string,
811:     ) => {
812:       if (streaming) {
813:         return;
814:       }
815: 
816:       const history: ChatMessage[] = userTurn ? [...base, userTurn] : base;
817: 
818:       const assistantId = newTurnId();
819:       const assistantIndex = history.length;
820:       setMessages([
821:         ...history,
822:         { role: "assistant", id: assistantId, parentId: assistantParentId, content: "", parts: [] },
823:       ]);
824:       setStreaming(true);
825:       setThinkingPhase("health_check");
826:       setOfflineReply(false);
827: 
828:       const controller = new AbortController();
829:       abortRef.current = controller;
830: 
831:       let content = "";
832:       let parts: ChatPart[] = [];
833:       let steps: RunStep[] = [];
834:       let failure: StudioError | null = null;
835:       let terminal = false;
836:       let stopped = false;
837: 
838:       // Prose is appended to the open text part; a surface opens a new one, so
839:       // the transcript keeps the agent's order instead of gathering all prose
840:       // above all cards.
841:       const appendText = (text: string) => {
842:         if (!text) {
843:           return;
844:         }
845:         content += text;
846:         const last = parts[parts.length - 1];
847:         parts =
848:           last?.kind === "text"
849:             ? [...parts.slice(0, -1), { kind: "text", text: last.text + text }]
850:             : [...parts, { kind: "text", text }];
851:       };
852: 
853:       // The turn owns its own timeline, so a finished run stays inspectable and
854:       // the next turn starts from nothing without a reset elsewhere.
855:       const publish = () => {
856:         setMessages((prev) => {
857:           if (prev.length <= assistantIndex) {
858:             return prev;
859:           }
860:           const next = [...prev];
861:           const retryText = userTurn?.content ?? base[base.length - 1]?.content ?? "";
862:           next[assistantIndex] = {
863:             role: "assistant",
864:             id: assistantId,
865:             parentId: assistantParentId,
866:             content,
867:             parts: [...parts],
868:             ...(failure ? { error: failure, retryText } : {}),
869:             ...(stopped ? { stopped: true, retryText } : {}),
870:             ...(steps.length ? { tools: [...steps] } : {}),
871:           };
872:           return next;
873:         });
874:       };

876:       const handleEvent = (event: RawSseEvent) => {
877:         switch (event.event) {
878:           case "status": {
879:             const phase = String(event.data.phase ?? "");
880:             setThinkingPhase(phase);
881:             if (phase === "offline") {
882:               setOfflineReply(true);
883:             }
884:             break;
885:           }
886:           case "delta": {
887:             appendText(String(event.data.text ?? ""));
888:             publish();
889:             break;
890:           }
891:           case "ui": {
892:             // Validate again on arrival: the connection is local but the
893:             // renderer must never trust a shape it has not checked.
894:             const parsed = parseUiSpec(event.data.spec, catalogManifest());
895:             if (parsed.ok) {
896:               parts = [
897:                 ...parts,
898:                 { kind: "ui", id: String(event.data.id ?? `ui-${parts.length}`), node: parsed.node },
899:               ];
900:               publish();
901:             }
902:             break;
903:           }
904:           case "tool":
905:             steps = applyToolEvent(
906:               steps,
907:               {
908:                 name: String(event.data.name ?? ""),
909:                 status: String(event.data.status ?? ""),
910:                 preview: event.data.preview ? String(event.data.preview) : undefined,
911:               },
912:               Date.now(),

914:             publish();
915:             break;
916:           case "message": {
917:             terminal = true;
918:             content = String(event.data.content ?? content);
919:             const hasSurfaces = parts.some((part) => part.kind === "ui");
920:             if (!hasSurfaces) {
921:               parts = content ? [{ kind: "text", text: content }] : [];
922:             }
923:             publish();
924:             break;
925:           }
926:           case "conversation": {
927:             const id = String(event.data.id ?? "");
928:             if (id) {
929:               setConversationId(id);
930:             }
931:             break;
932:           }
933:           case "memory": {
934:             const observation = event.data.observation as Observation | undefined;
935:             if (observation?.id) {
936:               setMemory((prev) =>
937:                 prev.some((item) => item.id === observation.id)
938:                   ? prev.map((item) => (item.id === observation.id ? observation : item))
939:                   : [...prev, observation],
940:               );
941:             }
942:             break;
943:           }
944:           case "canvas_dirty":
945:             void refreshCanvas();
946:             break;
947:           case "connector": {
948:             if (String(event.data.status ?? "") === "error") {
949:               const reason = String(event.data.error ?? "The connector could not be added.");
950:               setMessages((prev) => [
951:                 ...prev,
952:                 { role: "notice", id: newTurnId(), parentId: null, content: `Connector failed: ${reason}` },
953:               ]);
954:             } else {
955:               setConnectorSuggestions((prev) => {
956:                 const id = String(event.data?.preset ?? event.data?.name ?? "");
957:                 if (!id || prev.includes(id)) {
958:                   return prev;
959:                 }
960:                 return [...prev, id];
961:               });
962:             }
963:             void refreshConnectors();
964:             break;
965:           }
966:           case "error": {
967:             terminal = true;
968:             failure = readStudioError(event.data.error);
969:             publish();
970:             break;
971:           }
972:           default:
973:             break;
974:         }
975:       };
976: 
977:       try {
978:         await streamChat(
979:           {
980:             base_url: settings.base_url,
981:             api_key: settings.api_key,
982:             model: settings.model_name,
983:             mcp_url: settings.mcp_url,
984:             messages: history,
985:             brief,
986:             ui_catalog: catalogManifest(),
987:             conversation_id: conversationId,
988:           },
989:           handleEvent,
990:           controller.signal,
991:         );
992:       } catch (error) {
993:         const aborted = (error as Error).name === "AbortError";
994:         if (aborted) {
995:           // An abort is the user's own doing, so it is not a failure — but it is
996:           // still a fact about the turn. Keep what arrived, stop any tool that
997:           // was mid-flight, and leave the turn in place so the transcript says
998:           // what happened instead of silently losing the question.
999:           stopped = true;
1000:           steps = steps.map((step) =>
1001:             step.status === "running"
1002:               ? {
1003:                   ...step,
1004:                   status: "stopped",
1005:                   preview: step.preview ?? "Stopped before it returned.",
1006:                   endedAt: Date.now(),
1007:                 }
1008:               : step,
1009:           );
1010:           publish();
1011:         } else {
1012:           terminal = true;
1013:           failure = asStudioError(error);
1014:           publish();
1015:         }
1016:       } finally {
1017:         if (!terminal && !failure && !stopped) {
1018:           // The stream ended without a message or an error: something failed
1019:           // silently, and the user must still be told.
1020:           failure = {
1021:             code: "internal",
1022:             message: "The assistant stopped before answering.",
1023:             suggestion: "Try again — your question is still here.",
1024:             retryable: true,
1025:           };
1026:           publish();
1027:         }
1028:         setStreaming(false);
1029:         setThinkingPhase(null);
1030:         abortRef.current = null;
1031:       }
1032:     },
1033:     [streaming, settings, brief, conversationId, refreshCanvas, refreshConnectors],
